name: session-agent-toolkit
description: Lets an agent restart its own CLI session (or replace it with a fresh one) in the same terminal, e.g. to reload MCP servers while working unattended.

interface.shortDescription: Let the agent restart its own session
interface.longDescription: Restart the current agent CLI session in the same terminal, or replace it with a fresh session started from an activation prompt, with nobody at the keyboard.
capabilities: Restart the current session to reload MCP servers, plugins or settings
Hand the work over to a fresh session with an activation prompt
defaultPrompt: Restart this session so the new MCP server loads, then continue.
Write a handoff note and continue this task in a new session.
